website.note: /pipeline path returns 404; cancer page used as primary source

ctgov.note: Sponsor query returned 0 P1-3 records; secondary keyword search showed only terminated US trials (NCT02215902, NCT04453046, NCT04595903). Active oncology trial is registered in Australia.

pipeline.modality: Extracorporeal therapeutic device (lectin-affinity plasmapheresis cartridge using GNA affinity resin)
pipeline.target: Circulating extracellular vesicles (exosomes) and enveloped viruses

indications.indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors with stable or progressive disease on anti-PD-1 therapy (pembrolizumab or nivolumab); FDA Breakthrough Device designation
indications.trial_name: Australian safety, feasibility and dose-finding study of the Hemopurifier in solid tumors on anti-PD-1
indications.trial_design: Open-label, single-arm, three sequential cohorts (1, 2, or 3 treatments over one week); ~9-18 patients across Royal Adelaide Hospital, Pindara Private Hospital (Gold Coast), and GenesisCare North Shore (Sydney)
indications.trial_status: Recruiting / ongoing — two of three cohorts completed per company disclosure; DSMB reported no safety concerns; planned similarly designed trial in India (Medanta Medicity Hospital) pending CDSCO no-objection letter and Site Initiation Visit
key_milestones: Two of three Australian cohorts completed
HREC approval obtained at Medanta Medicity Hospital for India trial; awaiting CDSCO no-objection letter

excluded_preclinical: Hemopurifier in Long COVID (preclinical / hypothesis-generation only)
Hemopurifier in additional viral indications (Ebola, Marburg, Zika, Lassa, MERS-CoV, CMV, EBV, HSV) — preclinical capture data only; no active trial
